verdict.rationale: Otter's enterprise page offers an organization-level option to "keep your organization's data out of AI model training," arranged through an account manager. A community member's reading of the privacy statement confirms that recordings are otherwise used in anonymized form as training data. The pack contains no evidence of SOC 2 or HIPAA posture, and nothing shows how the opt-out is enforced or verified. missing for 10: documented SOC 2 attestation, HIPAA/BAA posture, self-serve or contractually documented enforcement of the training opt-out, detailed first-party training-data policy documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the vendor documents whether meeting data trains AI models and gives my org an enforceable opt-out, alongside SOC 2 / HIPAA posture

citations.quote: Keep your organization's data out of AI model training. Contact your account manager to get started.
recordings are retained in the cloud and used, "anonymized," as training data
